title: Quiz 3 — Earth Materials, Geohazards & PAGASA
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which rock type forms when magma or lava cools?
Which Philippine province is famous for marble?
Why is loam the best soil for most crops?
options: It drains well yet holds water
It is made almost entirely of sand
It is sticky clay that holds all water
It has no organic matter to rot roots
questions.correct: It drains well yet holds water

questions.text: A mineral sample fizzes when dilute acid is dropped on it. What can you conclude?
options: It contains a carbonate like calcite
It is made of pure gold metal inside
It is a type of quartz crystal only
It is a soft clay mineral from rivers
questions.correct: It contains a carbonate like calcite

questions.text: Which agency raises volcano alert levels in the Philippines?
What is a lahar?
Which is a natural warning sign of a tsunami?
options: A rainbow forming over the bay

questions.text: Coastal wells are turning salty while the land nearby is slowly sinking. Which single cause BEST explains both?
options: Volcanic ash falling on the town

questions.text: What is a storm surge?
options: Seawater pushed ashore by a storm
Rain falling very hard for an hour
A crack forming on a steep hillside
A wave caused by an undersea quake
questions.correct: Seawater pushed ashore by a storm

questions.text: Which part of a typhoon has the strongest winds?
Signal No. 2 is raised, but PAGASA also issues a Red rainfall warning for your low-lying area. What should you do?
options: Stay home — Signal No. 2 means low danger
Wait — only Signal No. 5 needs evacuation
Go outside to check how high the river is

questions.text: Why did the storm surge during Typhoon Yolanda cause so much damage in Tacloban?
options: Strong winds pushed water into a shallow, narrow bay
An earthquake happened at the very same time in the bay
The typhoon was very weak but stayed for a month
Mangroves along the coast made the waves stronger
questions.correct: Strong winds pushed water into a shallow, narrow bay

questions.text: What is an ipo-ipo?
options: A long dry period in summer
A large wave from the open sea

questions.text: Which activity MOST increases landslide risk?
When does a hazard become a disaster?
options: When it badly hurts a vulnerable community
Whenever it happens far out at sea, away from land
Only when it is caused by humans
Every time PAGASA names a typhoon
questions.correct: When it badly hurts a vulnerable community

questions.text: A city plans to fill a wetland to build a mall. Which judgment about flood risk is BEST?
options: Risky — but only for the mall itself

questions.text: What does the heat index measure?
Which heat index range is labeled DANGER by PAGASA?
What does PAGASA's iHeatMap show?
options: Current and forecast heat index by place
Water levels of rivers and dams each hour
Volcano alert levels for every province
questions.correct: Current and forecast heat index by place

questions.text: The iHeatMap forecasts a heat index of 44 °C at 1 p.m. in your town. When should a school schedule its outdoor sports practice?
options: Early morning, before the hottest hours
At 1 p.m., when the heat is at its peak
At noon, so practice ends before 1 p.m.
Any time, since heat index has no effect
questions.correct: Early morning, before the hottest hours
